wish: someone should make software that converts your humming into 8-bit music
spec:
Turns a hummed tune into a square-wave 8-bit melody drawn as a piano roll.
Tap Hum, hum a short phrase, tap Done; it plays back as Square, Pulse or Triangle and saves as an 8-bit WAV.
It does not do chords, rhythm quantising or multiple voices; monophonic pitch only.
notes: Mic pitch detection is untested headless; the example melody is shown first so the wall thumbnail is useful.
